headnotes.la: …tanus es tu; et daemonium habes? [n: (Joan. VIII, 48.)]* Fidem mentitur, cum, quod fidei Christianitatis ejus creditum est non servat; de qua beatus Augustinus in homilia 10 super epist. Joannis dicit
headnotes.en: …il? [n: (Joan. VIII, 48.)]* He lies against faith when he does not keep what was entrusted to the faith of his Christianity; concerning which blessed Augustine says in Homily 10 on the Epistle of John

headnotes.la: …er intuentur, ad hoc fiunt visibiliter, ut ab his a quibus fiunt fiant per mundationem conscientiarum invisibiliter. Unde B. Augustinus in tractatu sexto Epistolae S. Joannis Apostoli, sic de Baptismo
headnotes.en: … end: that by those who do them they may be done invisibly, through the cleansing of consciences. Whence blessed Augustine, in Tractate 6 on the Epistle of St. John the Apostle, thus speaks of Baptism

headnotes.la: …peres, quia in hoc Patrum conveniunt sententiae, ut Domino confitearis. Unde B. Joannes Chrysostomus super L psalmum [n: (homil. 2, ad hunc versum: Et peccatum meum contra me est semper, ante medium)]
headnotes.en: …the judgments of the Fathers agree — that you should confess to the Lord. Whence blessed John Chrysostom on Psalm 50 [n: (homil. 2, ad hunc versum: Et peccatum meum contra me est semper, ante medium)]

headnotes.la: Item idem super Epistolam ad Hebraeos [n: (super cap. 12 hom. 31, post medium)]
headnotes.en: Likewise the same, on the Epistle to the Hebrews [n: (super cap. 12 hom. 31, post medium)]

headnotes.la: *Revela Domino viam tuam [n: (Psal. XXXVI, 5)]*, *382* et tunc demum spera misericordiam te posse consequi. Et in septem collationibus ultimis Joannes Cassianus [n: (collat. 20, cap. 8)]
headnotes.en: *Reveal thy way to the Lord [n: (Psal. XXXVI, 5)]*, *382* and then at last hope that you can obtain mercy. And in the last seven Conferences John Cassian [n: (collat. 20, cap. 8)]

headnotes.la: …em latere non possunt, confiteri ea jugi supplicatione non desinas, qui et absque ullius verecundiae publicatione curare, et sine improperio peccata donare consuevit. Maximus in sermone paschali dicit
headnotes.en: …th unceasing supplication to him from whom they cannot lie hidden — who is wont both to heal without the publishing of any shame, and to forgive sins without reproach. Maximus says in an Easter sermon
And Leo, the tongue of the Holy Spirit

headnotes.la: …i peccaverit in te frater tuus, corripe eum inter te et ipsum solum [n: (Matth. XVIII, 15)]*. De qua sententia B. Augustinus sic in verbis evangelii dicit [n: (Serm. 16 de verb. Domini, c. 4, tom. X)]
headnotes.en: …d against thee, rebuke him between thee and him alone [n: (Matth. XVIII, 15)]*. Of which sentence blessed Augustine speaks thus in his words on the Gospel [n: (Serm. 16 de verb. Domini, c. 4, tom. X)]

headnotes.la: …, quia enim secretum fuit quando in te peccavit; secretum quaere, cum corrigis quod peccavit: nam si solus nosti quod peccavit in te, et eum vis coram omnibus corrigere, non es corrector, sed proditor
headnotes.en: … against you; seek secrecy when you correct what he has sinned: for if you alone know that he has sinned against you, and you wish to correct him before all men, you are not a corrector but a betrayer

headnotes.la: …quando in te peccavit; secretum quaere, cum corrigis quod peccavit: nam si solus nosti quod peccavit in te, et eum vis coram omnibus corrigere, non es corrector, sed proditor. « Item idem [n: (ibid.)]
headnotes.en: …u correct what he has sinned: for if you alone know that he has sinned against you, and you wish to correct him before all men, you are not a corrector but a betrayer. « Likewise the same [n: (ibid.)]

headnotes.la: B. Hieronymus sic super Matthaeum dicit *(in cap. 18, in medio, ad illa verba: Si peccaverit in te, etc.)*
headnotes.en: Blessed Jerome speaks thus on Matthew *(in cap. 18, in medio, ad illa verba: Si peccaverit in te, etc.)*

headnotes.la: … Si, corrigere voluerint, omnimodis confessa detegimus, teste Spiritu sancto, Antichristi et proditores habemur. De quibus Felix papa [n: (FEL. 1, ep. 1, in medio tom. I Conciliorum editionis regiae)]
headnotes.en: … what has been confessed, then, the Holy Spirit being witness, we are accounted antichrists and betrayers. Concerning whom Pope Felix [n: (FEL. 1, ep. 1, in medio tom. I Conciliorum editionis regiae)]

headnotes.la: Quod vero quae confessa sunt sub nomine alterius culpae vindicari, vel secrete visa detegi non debeant, sic dicit Innocentius papa
headnotes.en: But that the things which have been confessed ought not to be punished under the name of another fault, nor things seen in secret to be uncovered, Pope Innocent thus says
